result.note: Brief item on planned UAE investment; one statements question on the headline target and the aluminium deal size, both stated in the story.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about UAE investment in India as reported in September 2026:
items: The UAE plans another USD 25 billion in Indian investment, with a longer-term target of USD 100 billion.
The aluminium complex among the UAE's recent Indian deals is valued at USD 25 billion.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the aluminium complex is valued at USD 11.5 billion, while USD 25 billion is the size of the planned new investment. Recent deals also include a bank stake and housing finance, and Emirati capital is pivoting towards India's gateway ports and shipyards.
questions.source: The UAE plans another USD 25 billion in Indian investment, targeting USD 100 billion in time, with recent deals spanning a bank stake, housing finance, and an USD 11.5 billion aluminium complex
